context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 浩二/嶋/死因/船員/楽団/黒澤/柳田/真正面

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、浩二、絶対、さんの、絶対、回想録、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, the way you handled postwar memoir sources in your paper — I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Steady, warm attention. Measured pace. Genuine regard settling into each phrase. Eyes level, not looking past her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。歴史家の、本気で、絶対、嶋、絶対、先生の、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I drew a lot from Professor Shima's research—his work was so thorough, and I'm grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Slight warmth breaking through formality. Genuine gratitude, not performance. Voice settles at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的事件の、本気で、絶対、死因、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you examined historical cause and effect—your scope was really impressive. You didn't narrow your lens when you could have.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Deliberate, not rushing. Recognition of something that cost effort. Quiet emphasis on 'scope'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。海運時代の、本気で、絶対、船員、絶対、生活、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to understand the sailors' lives during the shipping era—not just the dates, but what it actually meant for them.
lines.style: Sincere and focused. Deliberate delivery, like she's explaining something that mattered to her, not just to the assignment. Slight intensity in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、楽団、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your section on prewar orchestra activity—that showed real engagement with the material.
lines.style: Noticing detail, not just praising broadly. Measured tone. The recognition of someone watching closely. Slight warmth on 'real engagement'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。映画監督の、本気で、絶対、黒澤、絶対、明、絶対、作品、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: That section came from wanting to understand Kurosawa's work in its historical moment—how the films reflected the era.
lines.style: More animated now. Still respectful, but her genuine interest showing through. Pace slightly quicker. Pride in the work, carefully contained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 民俗学の、本気で、絶対、柳田、絶対、國男、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of Yanagita Kunio's folklore work was particularly thoughtful. That's not easy territory.
lines.style: Genuine recognition of difficulty undertaken. Slight nod in the voice. Respect for the attempt, not just the result. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、真正面、絶対、からの議論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I wanted to approach it head-on, the way the history demanded. Not stepping around the hard questions. That felt important.
lines.style: Voice steadier now, more confident. Direct, almost earnest-fierce. The voice of someone who stands by a choice. No apology, just clarity.
